body.html: Who 21st Floor Residence suits best — to put it as briefly as possible, 21st Floor Residence Pattaya is a stay for people who want the feeling of "having their own sea-view condo for a couple of nights" rather than staying at a big chain hotel with a fancy lobby · it's a small serviced apartment where the operator takes suites on the 21st floor of the R-Con Wongamat Suite building and rents them out by the night, so each unit is a real suite with a small kitchen, a fridge and a private balcony — not a standard hotel room · according to the booking platforms, it's classed as 4-star, has around 20 units, and sits in the Wong Amat area of Na Kluea sub-district, a part of North Pattaya known for being quieter than the city centre · the people who fit here best are couples who want a sea-view room on a modest budget, small families who want a kitchen for reheating food or making simple meals for the kids, and travellers staying several nights who don't want to eat out every meal · on the flip side, if you're expecting full hotel-style service like a 4–5-star property — a concierge, all-day room service, or an in-house restaurant open for every meal — a small place like this may not be the answer, and you should look at a chain hotel in the same area instead · what we need to say straight from the start is that this is a very small property, so the number of reviews on the platforms is still low, and the average score you see (around 7.5) comes from a small sample, so read it as a "trend" rather than a settled number.

Location and getting around — the most appealing thing about 21st Floor Residence is its location in the Wong Amat area, a beach on the North Pattaya side that runs into Na Kluea sub-district · the full address is 677 Moo 5, Soi Na Kluea 16, R-Con Wongamat Suite building · according to the booking platforms, it's only about 350 m from Wong Amat Beach, an easy walk · Wong Amat Beach is one that many Pattaya locals prefer over Central Pattaya Beach, because the sand is whiter, the water is clearer and the atmosphere is calmer thanks to being away from the main entertainment district · there are several other points of interest around the property — the Sanctuary of Truth is close by, around 1–1.5 km away, and Na Kluea Market, a source of fresh seafood and local food, isn't far either · Central Pattaya Beach and the beachfront road are about 2–4 km away, a few minutes by car · one thing to note about getting around is that the Wong Amat area is a quiet zone that's more about accommodation than shops, so calling a Grab or a motorbike taxi is possible but at times you may wait longer than in the city, and having your own car or a rented motorbike makes getting around much easier · for those flying in, U-Tapao Airport (UTP) is about a 45–55 min drive away, while Suvarnabhumi is about 1.5 hr.

"I chose this place because I wanted a room with a kitchen and a sea-view balcony. Waking up to the sea every morning was so worth it, Wong Amat Beach is just a short walk away, and it's a lot quieter than the central beach. Really good for a proper rest."

Room types and decor — because 21st Floor Residence is condo suites opened up for rent, each unit is more of a studio- or one-bedroom-style suite with a small kitchen (kitchenette) than a hotel room that looks the same as every other one · from what we could gather, most rooms come with a private balcony, air conditioning, a fridge, a satellite flat-screen TV and a bathroom with a shower, and some units have a separate dressing area · the selling point that sets it apart from a regular hotel is the small kitchen in the room, which lets you make coffee, reheat food or put together simple meals yourself — a real saving and very handy for longer stays or for those travelling with small children · as for the view, since it's on the 21st floor of a tall building, many rooms look out over Pattaya Bay or have a city view from up high, which is the main draw for people who choose to stay here · that said, because these are condo suites where each owner or manager may decorate differently, the room standard may be less consistent than a chain hotel's — some rooms may be newer and nicely done up, others older, depending on the unit you get · this is the nature of a small serviced apartment, where you trade hotel-perfect consistency for privacy and home-style living space · our advice is to look closely at photos of the actual unit you'll get when booking, and to ask the manager about the view and the condition of the room before confirming.

Facilities and the pool — because it's located in the R-Con Wongamat building, guests at 21st Floor Residence also get to use the building's shared facilities · the highlight is the outdoor pool, which gives a relaxed poolside feel, and some sources also mention a fitness room and other common areas of the building · something many people care about and that this place does well is free parking, which matters a lot for anyone driving down from Bangkok or renting a car to get around, because parking in Pattaya's tourist areas is often hard to find and comes at a cost · on top of that there's free Wi-Fi in all rooms, a reception counter, laundry service and airport transfer (at extra cost) · we have to be honest that, because it's a small property sharing facilities with the condo's residents, the pool and common areas aren't reserved for the hotel alone and may be shared with condo residents, so the privacy is different from a resort pool kept just for guests · but for general relaxing — a dip to cool off or a chill by the pool — it's plenty, and it's an advantage over similarly priced stays that have no pool at all.

Food and the in-room kitchen — the thing that most clearly sets 21st Floor Residence apart from a regular hotel is food, because instead of relying on a hotel restaurant, it gives you a small kitchen in the room to cook for yourself · for those on longer stays or travelling with family, having a kitchen, a fridge and basic equipment helps a lot — it saves on food costs and is handy when you want something simple late at night, or to warm milk or food for the kids · importantly, the Na Kluea area is a very good food spot — Na Kluea Market has fresh seafood at reasonable prices to buy and cook in the room, and the seafood restaurants in this area are well known · there are also restaurants, cafés and convenience stores within close range, so finding food is no trouble · one thing to know is that, because it's a small serviced apartment, breakfast may not be included in the room rate as a hotel buffet — it depends on the package you book, and sometimes you'll need to prepare it or head out yourself, which isn't a problem given the kitchen and the shops around · overall, if you like to cook for yourself or want to keep your food budget in check during a trip, this is an advantage you won't find from a regular hotel at the same price.

Service — the service at a small serviced apartment like 21st Floor Residence is quite different from a chain hotel's, and it's something to set your expectations on from the start · the upside is that small places tend to look after you in a close, friendly way — the manager replies to messages or helps coordinate check-in, suggests places to eat and visit, or calls a car for you, more like a local friend than a hotel employee · from the information available, the place has a reception counter and basic services like laundry and airport transfer · but the limitation you have to accept is that the service isn't the full 24-hour kind you get at a big hotel, and in the reviews that exist (few as they are) there are comments about the cleanliness of some units not being as good as it should be, mixed in with praise for the location and value · because it involves looking after many suites that may have different owners, the standard of cleaning and responsiveness can be inconsistent · our advice is to communicate clearly with the manager before your stay — about check-in time, the condition of the room and cleanliness — to reduce the chance of surprises.

What real reviews say (both praise and gripes) — we have to be upfront that 21st Floor Residence is a small property with very few reviews on the platforms, so the picture isn't as settled or comprehensive as a big hotel with thousands of reviews · as far as we could gather, the average score sits at around 7.5/10, in the "very good" range · on the praise side, what comes up consistently is the quiet Wong Amat location close to Wong Amat Beach, the sea view from the high-floor balcony, the value for money given that you get a suite with a kitchen, and the friendly service from the manager · on the watch-out side, the most-raised point is the cleanliness of some units not being good enough, which is worth being careful about and asking about before your stay · next is the inconsistent room standard, because these are multiple suites, and the service not being as complete as a big hotel's · the overall picture is that this is a place that "stands out for location and views, in exchange for less-settled service and cleanliness standards" — a problem you can lower the risk of by choosing your unit, looking at real photos, and talking to the manager in detail before booking.

"Good location, lovely view, friendly and helpful staff, great value · my only gripe is that when I got into the room I felt some spots could have been cleaner. I let them know and they came and sorted it out. Next time I'll ask about the room in detail first."

Price comparison and value — the starting price for 21st Floor Residence is around THB 1,000/night in normal periods, and it can climb during festivals or long weekends · compared with hotels in the Wong Amat / North Pattaya area, the draw here isn't luxury or full service, but getting a suite with a kitchen, a private balcony and a sea view from a high floor at an affordable price · if you compare the same money against a regular 3-star hotel in town where you just get a bare bedroom, getting a kitchen, a fridge and home-style living space is worth it for those on longer stays or travelling as a family · but if you compare it with a big 4-star chain hotel at a similar price, you have to accept that here you trade complete service and a settled standard for privacy and a quiet beachfront location · in short, the value here depends on how much you value "a suite with a kitchen and a sea view in a quiet area" — if that's you, this price is worth it; if you want full hotel service, there may be better-suited options for the same budget.

What to know before you book — there are several things that help make a stay at 21st Floor Residence go more smoothly · one, because these are multiple suites that may be decorated differently, look at photos of the actual unit you'll get and ask the manager about the view and the condition of the room before confirming your booking · two, the most-criticised point is cleanliness, so we'd suggest you state your cleanliness needs in advance and check the room at check-in, and if you find anything not okay, report it right away so it can be dealt with quickly · three, the place shares its common facilities with the condo's residents, so set your expectations about the pool and common areas accordingly · four, if you drive yourself, the free parking is a plus, but you should ask about the number and location of spaces in advance · five, the Wong Amat area is quiet and accommodation-focused, so having a car or a motorbike makes getting around easier · six, check-in is after 3:00 PM and check-out before 12:00 PM as standard, but confirm with the manager again, as small places can be flexible · seven, book through a platform with free cancellation first if your plans aren't set, because small places sometimes have different conditions from big hotels.

Verdict — from the information and real reviews we gathered, 21st Floor Residence Pattaya is the best fit for people who want a suite with a kitchen and a sea-view balcony, in the quiet Wong Amat area, within walking distance of the beach, on an affordable budget · its charm is the feeling of having your own sea-view condo for a while, with a kitchen to cook your own meals, in a North Pattaya zone that's more laid-back than the city centre, plus free parking and a shared pool · but you have to accept honestly that this is a small property where service and cleanliness standards aren't as settled as a chain hotel's, some reviews fault the cleanliness of certain units, and the number of reviews on the platforms is still low, so read the score as a trend · if you're after full 4–5-star hotel service, or want a settled standard in every corner, this may not be the answer, and you should consider a chain hotel in the same area instead · but for those who understand the nature of a serviced apartment and choose their unit and talk to the manager before booking — 21st Floor Residence offers "a sea-view suite at a lovely price" that isn't easy to find in the Wong Amat area.

faqTitle: Frequently Asked Questions — 21st Floor Residence Pattaya

faq.q: Where is 21st Floor Residence Pattaya · can you walk to the beach?
faq.a: The property is on the 21st floor of the R-Con Wongamat Suite building at 677 Moo 5, Soi Na Kluea 16, in the Wong Amat area, Na Kluea sub-district, North Pattaya · it's about 350 m from Wong Amat Beach and walkable · it's close to the Sanctuary of Truth and Na Kluea Market, while Central Pattaya Beach is about 2–4 km away.

faq.q: Is 21st Floor Residence a hotel or an apartment?
faq.a: It's a small serviced apartment (apart-hotel) of around 20 units that takes suites in the R-Con Wongamat condo and rents them out by the night · each room is a real suite with a small kitchen, a fridge and a private balcony, not a standard hotel room, so it feels like having your own sea-view condo for a while.

faq.q: What's the starting price at 21st Floor Residence?
faq.a: Prices start from about THB 1,000/night for a studio suite with a kitchen in normal periods · one-bedroom sea-view rooms and festival periods are pricier · because it's a small property, we'd suggest comparing prices on Agoda and other platforms, then choosing free cancellation first if your plans aren't set.

faq.q: Do the rooms have a kitchen, and is there a pool?
faq.a: Yes · every unit is a suite with a small kitchen (kitchenette) and a fridge so you can make simple meals yourself · and there's a shared outdoor pool in the R-Con Wongamat building for guests to use, plus free Wi-Fi and free parking · one thing to know is that the common facilities are shared with the condo's residents.

faq.q: Who is 21st Floor Residence suited to?
faq.a: It suits couples and small families who want a suite with a kitchen and a sea-view balcony, in the quiet Wong Amat area, on an affordable budget, and people on longer stays who want to cook for themselves · if you want full 4–5-star hotel service or a settled standard in every corner, a chain hotel in the same area may suit you better.

faq.q: What are cleanliness and service like at 21st Floor Residence?
faq.a: Because it's a small property looking after multiple suites, the standard of cleanliness and service may be inconsistent, and some reviews (few as they are) fault the cleanliness of certain units · we'd suggest you look at photos of the real unit, ask the manager before booking, and check the room at check-in, reporting anything not okay right away so it can be dealt with quickly.
